### file: .env
# Generated by `songstress install` — secrets live HERE and only here
# (mode 0600). songstress.lock.json carries no secrets. Re-running the
# installer keeps every password and key below.

# ── basics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TZ=UTC
PUID=1000
PGID=1000
MUSIC_DIR=/srv/music
SONGSTRESS_PORT=8090
ENABLE_TELEMETRY=true

# ── app admin (sign-in for web, desktop & mobile) ────────────────────────────
SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL=a@b.c
SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=sct.admin.7f3k

# ── public URL (set this if you front Songstress with a proxy/tunnel) ────────
# The origin you serve Songstress on, e.g. https://music.example.com. Makes
# invite & password-reset email links resolve; blank is fine on a LAN.
SONGSTRESS_PUBLIC_URL=

# ── Navidrome (managed sibling service) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Navidrome creates its 'admin' with this password on its FIRST boot only, so
# it must never change while data/navidrome exists.
NAVIDROME_PASSWORD=sct.nd.7f3k
# Navidrome's port on this host, for other Subsonic apps.
NAVIDROME_PORT=4533

# ── Discovery (AudioMuse-AI side-car) ────────────────────────────────────────

# ── VPN egress (gluetun) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES=10.2.0.2/32

# ── your settings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Add any of the README's "Settings" below (LOG_LEVEL, SONGSTRESS_MEM_LIMIT,
# SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, …); a re-run writes them back unchanged.

### file: compose.discovery.yaml
# Generated by `songstress install` — Discovery (AudioMuse-AI) overlay.
# AudioMuse is AGPL-3.0 and runs unmodified from upstream images
# (https://github.com/NeptuneHub/AudioMuse-AI). Internal-only: Songstress is
# the management surface.
services:
  songstress:
    depends_on:
      audiomuse:
        condition: service_started

  audiomuse:
    image: ghcr.io/neptunehub/audiomuse-ai:2.6.1
    container_name: songstress-audiomuse
    environment:
      - SERVICE_TYPE=flask
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - POSTGRES_USER=audiomuse
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${AUDIOMUSE_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=audiomusedb
      - POSTGRES_HOST=audiomuse-postgres
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - REDIS_URL=redis://audiomuse-redis:6379/0
      # Headless config (live-verified): MEDIASERVER_TYPE is REQUIRED or all
      # NAVIDROME_* is silently ignored; AUDIOMUSE_USER/PASSWORD create its
      # admin — without one every API call 403s with "Setup required".
      - MEDIASERVER_TYPE=navidrome
      - NAVIDROME_URL=http://navidrome:4533
      - NAVIDROME_USER=admin
      - NAVIDROME_PASSWORD=${NAVIDROME_PASSWORD}
      - AUTH_ENABLED=true
      - AUDIOMUSE_USER=admin
      - AUDIOMUSE_PASSWORD=${AUDIOMUSE_PASSWORD}
      - API_TOKEN=${AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN}
    depends_on:
      - audiomuse-postgres
      - audiomuse-redis
    restart: unless-stopped

  audiomuse-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/neptunehub/audiomuse-ai:2.6.1
    container_name: songstress-audiomuse-worker
    environment:
      - SERVICE_TYPE=worker
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - POSTGRES_USER=audiomuse
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${AUDIOMUSE_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=audiomusedb
      - POSTGRES_HOST=audiomuse-postgres
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - REDIS_URL=redis://audiomuse-redis:6379/0
      - MEDIASERVER_TYPE=navidrome
      - NAVIDROME_URL=http://navidrome:4533
      - NAVIDROME_USER=admin
      - NAVIDROME_PASSWORD=${NAVIDROME_PASSWORD}
      - AUDIOMUSE_USER=admin
      - AUDIOMUSE_PASSWORD=${AUDIOMUSE_PASSWORD}
      - API_TOKEN=${AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN}
    depends_on:
      - audiomuse-postgres
      - audiomuse-redis
    restart: unless-stopped

  audiomuse-postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: songstress-audiomuse-postgres
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - POSTGRES_USER=audiomuse
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${AUDIOMUSE_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=audiomusedb
    volumes:
      - audiomuse-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped

  audiomuse-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: songstress-audiomuse-redis
    volumes:
      - audiomuse-redisdata:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  audiomuse-pgdata:
  audiomuse-redisdata:

### file: compose.vpn.yaml
# Generated by `songstress install` — VPN egress overlay. The songstress
# service joins gluetun's network namespace (wired in compose.yaml), so all
# acquisition egress rides the tunnel; Navidrome stays outside it, reached over
# LAN_SUBNET, so streaming is unaffected by tunnel hiccups.
services:
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:v3
    container_name: songstress-gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    ports:
      # Published here because songstress shares this network namespace.
      - "${SONGSTRESS_PORT}:8090"
    volumes:
      - ./gluetun:/gluetun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=${VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER}
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES=${WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES}
      # Keep the UI reachable and let LAN/Docker traffic bypass the tunnel.
      - FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS=8090
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=${LAN_SUBNET}
      # Keep Docker DNS so `navidrome`/`audiomuse` resolve from this netns.
      - DNS_KEEP_NAMESERVER=on
      - TZ=${TZ}
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Rotated like compose.yaml's services (YAML anchors don't cross files).
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "10"
    # A WireGuard tunnel idles at tens of MB; the ceiling only stops a runaway.
    mem_limit: ${GLUETUN_MEM_LIMIT:-256m}
    cpus: ${GLUETUN_CPUS:-0}

### file: compose.yaml
# Generated by `songstress install` — re-run it to change anything (passwords,
# keys and your data are kept).
# Songstress (datastore, dashboard, acquisition worker) + official Navidrome.

# Container log rotation: Docker's json-file driver never rotates on its own,
# so each service keeps 10 x 50 MB — well over the 14 days an incident review
# needs.
x-logging: &logging
  driver: json-file
  options:
    max-size: "50m"
    max-file: "10"

services:
  songstress:
    image: ghcr.io/pacholoamit/songstress:v0.35.0
    container_name: songstress
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - PUID=${PUID}
      - PGID=${PGID}
      - SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL=${SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL}
      - SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      # Public URL — the origin your reverse proxy / tunnel serves this on. Sets
      # the app URL baked into invite & password-reset email links (otherwise
      # they point at http://localhost:8090). Empty is fine on a LAN.
      - SONGSTRESS_PUBLIC_URL=${SONGSTRESS_PUBLIC_URL:-}
      - ENABLE_TELEMETRY=${ENABLE_TELEMETRY}
      - MUSIC_LIBRARIES=Main=/music
      # Managed Navidrome: Songstress provisions + drives the service below and
      # checks at every start that it can sign in to it as an admin.
      - SONGSTRESS_MANAGED_NAVIDROME=1
      - NAVIDROME_URL=http://navidrome:4533
      - NAVIDROME_USERNAME=admin
      - NAVIDROME_PASSWORD=${NAVIDROME_PASSWORD:?set NAVIDROME_PASSWORD in .env (any strong value)}
      # Email (optional; empty host/to = disabled). Set via `.env` — the install
      # wizard's SMTP group writes them; these defaults cover the unset case.
      - SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST:-}
      - SMTP_PORT=${SMTP_PORT:-587}
      - SMTP_USERNAME=${SMTP_USERNAME:-}
      - SMTP_PASSWORD=${SMTP_PASSWORD:-}
      - SMTP_FROM=${SMTP_FROM:-}
      - SMTP_TO=${SMTP_TO:-}
      - SMTP_STARTTLS=${SMTP_STARTTLS:-true}
      # Discovery side-car (see compose.discovery.yaml).
      - AUDIOMUSE_URL=http://audiomuse:8000
      - AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN=${AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN}
      # ── optional settings: add any of them to .env (a re-run keeps them).
      # The defaults are the server's own; README "Settings" explains each.
      - SONGSTRESS_PB_EGRESS=${SONGSTRESS_PB_EGRESS:-direct}
      - LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
      - WRAPPED_REEL_MODE=${WRAPPED_REEL_MODE:-motion}
      # Acquisition engine: seeds the dashboard's settings on first boot only.
      - SWEEP_CRON=${SWEEP_CRON:-0 */6 * * *}
      - WORKERS=${WORKERS:-5}
      - DURATION_TOLERANCE_S=${DURATION_TOLERANCE_S:-3}
      - SERVICE_ORDER=${SERVICE_ORDER:-}
      - SPOTIFLAC_SOURCES=${SPOTIFLAC_SOURCES:-}
      - DISCOGRAPHY_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE=${DISCOGRAPHY_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE:-}
      - FILENAME_TEMPLATE=${FILENAME_TEMPLATE:-}
      - RETRY_TRANSIENT_HOURS=${RETRY_TRANSIENT_HOURS:-6}
      - RETRY_NOMATCH_DAYS=${RETRY_NOMATCH_DAYS:-30}
      - ROTATE_AFTER_FAILS=${ROTATE_AFTER_FAILS:-6}
      - MAX_ROTATIONS=${MAX_ROTATIONS:-50}
      - HISTORY_IMPORT_PATH=${HISTORY_IMPORT_PATH:-}
      # Integrations: seed their connections on first boot only.
      - SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID:-}
      - SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET=${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      - SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI=${SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI:-}
      - LASTFM_API_KEY=${LASTFM_API_KEY:-}
      - LASTFM_API_SECRET=${LASTFM_API_SECRET:-}
      - GLUETUN_URL=${GLUETUN_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}
      - GLUETUN_API_KEY=${GLUETUN_API_KEY:-}
      - YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE=${YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE:-}
      # Acquisition providers: API keys and endpoint overrides.
      - SONGSTRESS_ANTRA_API_KEY=${SONGSTRESS_ANTRA_API_KEY:-}
      - SONGSTRESS_COMMUNITY_API_KEY=${SONGSTRESS_COMMUNITY_API_KEY:-}
      - SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_ID=${SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_ID:-}
      - SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_SECRET=${SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_SECRET:-}
      - SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS=${SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS:-}
      - SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS_REFRESH=${SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS_REFRESH:-}
    # All egress rides gluetun's network namespace (see compose.vpn.yaml);
    # the dashboard port is published on the gluetun service.
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/pb/pb_data
      - ${MUSIC_DIR}:/music
    tmpfs:
      # Bounded, and counted inside mem_limit: Soulseek transfers in flight and
      # a Wrapped render together peak near 1.2 GB. Past the cap a write fails
      # and is retried, instead of the container running out of memory.
      - /tmp:mode=1777,size=${SONGSTRESS_TMP_SIZE:-1536m}
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_started
      navidrome:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging
    # PocketBase, the worker, ffmpeg and headless Chromium share this ceiling;
    # at it the kernel kills a process inside and supervisord restarts it. CPU
    # caps are off (0) unless set — never above the host's CPU count, or Docker
    # refuses to start the container.
    mem_limit: ${SONGSTRESS_MEM_LIMIT:-4g}
    cpus: ${SONGSTRESS_CPUS:-0}

  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:0.62.0
    container_name: songstress-navidrome
    user: "${PUID}:${PGID}"
    depends_on:
      navidrome-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - ND_MUSICFOLDER=/music
      - ND_DATAFOLDER=/data
      - ND_PORT=4533
      # Songstress triggers scans after acquisitions — no double-scanning.
      - ND_SCANNER_SCHEDULE=0
      - ND_SCANNER_WATCHERWAIT=0
      - ND_SCANNER_SCANONSTARTUP=true
      - ND_ENABLETRANSCODINGCONFIG=true
      # Creates the 'admin' user on Navidrome's FIRST boot only — which is why
      # re-running the installer never changes NAVIDROME_PASSWORD.
      - ND_DEVAUTOCREATEADMINPASSWORD=${NAVIDROME_PASSWORD:?set NAVIDROME_PASSWORD in .env (any strong value)}
    ports:
      # For other Subsonic apps: Songstress serves all media itself. Re-run with
      # --publish-navidrome=false to keep Navidrome off the host.
      - "${NAVIDROME_PORT}:4533"
    volumes:
      # ND data nested under the datastore root — one directory to back up.
      - ./data/navidrome:/data
      - ${MUSIC_DIR}:/music:ro
    healthcheck:
      # The official image ships no HEALTHCHECK; songstress gates on this.
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:4533/ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging
    # Sized for a full scan: a cap below its peak would kill the scan on every
    # start, over and over (ND_SCANNER_SCANONSTARTUP).
    mem_limit: ${NAVIDROME_MEM_LIMIT:-3g}
    cpus: ${NAVIDROME_CPUS:-0}

  # One-shot: hands ./data/navidrome to PUID:PGID before Navidrome starts. On
  # Linux a missing bind-mount source is created root-owned, Navidrome (running
  # as PUID:PGID) can't write its database, never turns healthy, and songstress
  # never starts. The installer pre-creates the directory too; this covers a
  # later `docker compose up` after it was deleted.
  navidrome-init:
    image: deluan/navidrome:0.62.0
    user: "0:0"
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "mkdir -p /data && chown ${PUID}:${PGID} /data"]
    volumes:
      - ./data/navidrome:/data
    restart: "no"
    logging: *logging
